python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0038.png"))
# Find floor contacts of the 4 table legs in obs_0038
# Frame 38 pose:
# let us inspect each leg
# The legs are vertical brown columns:
wood_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 1] < 65) & (img[:, :, 2] < 35)

# Columns where legs exist:
# Front-left leg around u ~ 210
# Front-center/right leg around u ~ 260
# Back-right leg around u ~ 335
# Back-center leg around u ~ 295
legs = [
    ("front", 250, 270),
    ("left", 205, 225),
    ("back-mid", 290, 305),
    ("back-right", 330, 345)
]

for name, u1, u2 in legs:
    sub = wood_mask[:, u1:u2]
    vs, us = np.where(sub)
    if len(vs) > 0:
        v_bottom = vs.max()
        u_bottom = u1 + us[vs == v_bottom].mean()
        print(f"Leg {name}: u={u_bottom:.1f}, v={v_bottom}")
'
